html:
In 376 large numbers of Goths, mostly Tervingi led by Fritigern, asked to cross the Danube into the Roman Empire. They were fleeing the Huns, who had broken the Gothic kingdoms north of the Black Sea. The emperor Valens let them in, hoping for soldiers and farmers.

It went badly. Roman officials in Thrace kept them short of food and sold it at cruel prices; some Goths were said to have sold their children for dog meat. Other groups crossed without leave. Within months the Goths rose in revolt and plundered the Balkans.

This started the Gothic War of 376 to 382. In 378 the Goths destroyed the eastern army and killed Valens at the Battle of Adrianople. It was the first time a whole people settled inside the empire on its own terms, and it opened the Migration Period.
